equipment_type: Air-cooled variable-speed screw chiller (via SC-EQ card)
applies_to: YORK YVAA Style B air-cooled variable-speed screw chillers (two refrigerant systems) fitted with the SC-EQ communication card.
summary: YORK by Johnson Controls YVAA Style B chillers connect to a BAS through the SC-EQ communication card on BACnet MS/TP (or Modbus RTU / N2). The BAS can start/stop the chiller and write the cooling setpoint, current limit and sound limit. Read-only points cover chilled liquid and ambient temperatures, per-system pressures, temperatures, % FLA, power and alarms, VSD values, and multistate operational, fault and warning codes per system.
notes: Access is inferred: the sheet has no read/write column. The remote block (AV 1-3, BV 1) is treated as commandable and MV 65001 as writable; everything else as read-only.
AV 37 and AV 42 mean subcooling on microchannel condensers and evaporator level on round-tube condensers; they are merged into one row each.
Operational, fault and warning code MVs (MV 1-4, MV 15-16) use the Status Codes tables + 1, as the sheet says to add 1 for BACnet MSV values; the AV copies use the raw code.

Multistate states with their own enum in the points table (Units, system state) are shown as printed, from 0. BACnet multistate values start at 1, so the device may report the printed number + 1; confirm by discovery (read the state text).
Units shown are the IP units; with MV 65001 set to SI the card reports °C, bar and so on.
The sheet also lists a Total Run Hours value (sum of both systems) with no BACnet object; it is left out.

source.title: YVAA Style B SC-EQ BAS Points List

integration.summary: Put the chiller in remote control (BV 20 reads Remote), then start/stop it with BV 1 and write the cooling setpoint (AV 1) and current limit (AV 2). Read BV 5 for chiller run, leaving chilled liquid temperature and VSD frequency, and BV 15/BV 16 for system alarms; the per-system fault codes give the cause.

minimum_points.name: LOCAL REMOTE CONTROL MODE
minimum_points.why: Must read Remote (1) for BMS control

integration.enable: BV 20 shows Local or Remote control mode. The points list gives no point to change it and no write-enable point.
integration.heartbeat: The operational code list includes 'Loss of External Communications'; the sheet gives no timeout or heartbeat point.
setup: The BAS connects to the SC-EQ J12 port (RS-485: +, -, COM/REF, SHLD). The card detects BACnet MS/TP, Modbus RTU or N2 and the baud rate by itself; allow up to 120 seconds after power-up.
The MAC address (1-127) is set on DIP switch SW1 (switch 8 unused). Cycle the card's power after changing it.

The device instance defaults to 5000 + the MAC address (MAC 6 gives 5006). To use another number, set Device Instance Mode to Manual and enter the instance with the SC-AP / MAP tool, or write BV 65000 (mode) and AV 65000 (instance ID).
MV 65001 Units sets whether the BAS sees IP or SI values, independent of the chiller display; set it to match the chiller.
gotchas: The remote (commandable) setpoints read as unreliable until the BAS writes them the first time.
The SC-EQ only exposes the points that apply to the chiller it detects; if it replaces an E-Link, re-discover the device so old non-applicable points don't sit offline.
Fault/inhibit codes are per refrigerant system (MV 2, MV 4); there is no single unit fault code, so alarm on BV 15 and BV 16.
